en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large lumber mill complex in a river valley. In the foreground are neatly stacked piles of cut boards and lumber on rail tracks. In the middle ground stands an industrial mill building with a tall smokestack emitting smoke. A truss bridge crosses a river to the right, and rolling hills and scattered buildings form the background. Printed red text at the top left reads "Potlatch Mill. Palouse, Wash." Handwritten notes and numbers are visible across the upper portion of the card.
